# 'Want justice for my daughter's death': RG Kar rape victim's mother to contest Bengal polls on BJP ticket. ## The BJP has fielded the R G Kar rape victim's mother in Panihati constituency in North 24 Parganas. A 31-year-old doctor was raped and murdered inside the seminar hall of RG Kar Medical College and Hospital in August 2024. The mother of the RG Kar Medical College rape and murder victim will be contesting the upcoming West Bengal Assembly polls as a BJP candidate from Panihati constituency in North 24 Parganas. Speaking to the news agency ANI following her nomination, the victim's mother said, "This is also a victory. This victory is for the people of Panihati. I will not win the poll battle, the people of Panihati will win.". Cracking down on the ruling Trinamool Congress government in West Bengal, she said, "The government has snatched away the right to education, health, and the basic rights of the people. Speaking about her daughter, the mother said, "You know that my daughter was killed on duty in RG Kar Medical College and Hospital. I want to tell the people that I am zero now, I don't have anything...I will request them to stand by me.". Alleging that all evidence related to her daughter's death has been removed at the behest of Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee, the victim's mother said, "We will say to the people of the state, you have seen a government for the last 15 years. The father of the victim said the BJP has chosen his wife as a candidate from Panihati constituency. "She is the candidate of the people of Panihati. People of Panihati will vote for her and make her win. She will raise the issues of the people of Panihati in the Vidhan Sabha. Our doors will always be open for the people of Panihati...". A 31-year-old doctor was raped and murdered inside the seminar hall of RG Kar Medical College and Hospital in Kolkata in August 2024. The mother of the deceased doctor said she may contest from the Panihati constituency in North 24 Parganas. # “To ensure justice for my daughter”: RG Kar victim’s mother likely to contest Bengal polls on BJP ticket. ## Her decision comes amid continued allegations against the state government over attempts to obstruct justice in the high-profile case that shook the nation. The grieving mother of the RG Kar Medical College victim has announced that she may enter active politics by contesting the upcoming West Bengal Assembly elections as a candidate of the Bharatiya Janata Party. Speaking to reporters, she stated that her primary objective is to ensure justice for her daughter and to bring political change in the state. She alleged that the current government led by Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee attempted to obstruct the investigation into the brutal crime. “I am entering politics to ensure justice for my daughter and to remove this government from power,” she said. “At the same time, neither the BJP nor the TMC has shown real intent to uncover the truth,” he alleged, accusing the state government of destroying evidence and attempting a hurried cremation of the victim’s body—claims that have been strongly contested in the past. The entry of the victim’s mother into electoral politics shows how deeply the case has resonated with public sentiment in West Bengal. As the 2026 Assembly elections approach, her candidature, if finalised, could significantly influence the political discourse, particularly in regions affected by the protests and public outrage following the incident.
